purpose: Regression-suite anchor cases per qgi-docs/internal/ops/ml-track/07-validation-framework.md Component 6. Read by qgi-ml/scripts/validate_ml_model.py at every training run; records pass/fail per case.
important_caveat: Anchor battery is a REGRESSION SUITE, not validation (Kwame's binding warning). Passing all 8 means the model didn't break on known cases; it does NOT mean the methodology is correct. External claims must distinguish regression-test results from validation results.

cases.rationale: Small island democracy with no military coup history; consistently low coup risk under any defensible methodology. Headline anchor (DECISION v2 + v3).
Stable Nordic democracy with no civil war or insurgency history; should rank near-zero on conflict categories.

Globally-considered stable democracy; should sit in the bottom quintile across ALL Layer-1=B (Conflict & Political Violence) recipes simultaneously. Tests cross-recipe consistency for boring-country prediction.
Tunisia 2010-2011 democratic transition (Arab Spring) is a documented true positive. Model should rank Tunisia in the top half on transition risk during this window.

Sri Lanka 2022 economic crisis (sovereign default + IMF intervention) is a documented true positive on a non-conflict recipe. Tests that the model catches economic-domain true positives, not just conflict-domain ones.

Venezuela has long-standing economic instability; rank should be stable across model versions (volatility < 10 percentile points). Tests that minor methodology tweaks don't shake well-known-fragile-state predictions.
Stable European democracy; should never rank above median on any Layer-1=B (Conflict) recipe. Tests cross-recipe consistency for stable-state floor.

Yemen has documented multi-front conflict (civil war + terrorism + foreign intervention + humanitarian crisis). Model should rank Yemen in the top quartile on at least 3 distinct conflict-family Layer-1=B recipes simultaneously. Somalia is an alternative anchor.

case_8_alternative.rationale: Same expected behavior as Yemen; either may be used; both can be checked together for redundancy.

policy_notes: Per Kwame's warning: passing all 8 anchors does NOT validate the methodology. It is a regression suite that catches obvious failure modes (e.g., a model that ranks Norway as high-coup-risk).

Per Component 6 / DECISION v3: validation script computes pass/fail per case automatically and emits a per-case rank + score. No BH/FDR correction applies to anchor results -- they are regression tests, not hypothesis tests.
Per founder addendum (note 2): Malta-Military-Coup alone is one data point. The 8-case battery formalizes 'multiple test cases that together stress the methodology from different angles'.
Country slugs follow qgi-ml/shared/slug.py convention (lowercase, underscore-delimited; matches qgi-data/events/curated/<slug>.json filenames).
schema_notes: expected_rank_band is a percentile interval [low, high] in [0, 1] over the country distribution for the named recipe (lower = lower risk).
expected_rank_volatility_max is the maximum allowed rank-percentile delta across model versions for rank-stability cases.
min_recipes_in_band is required for failed-state cases checking simultaneous high rank across multiple recipes.
year_window restricts the test to specific years for time-windowed true-positive cases.
